title: Is the combat in my game too difficult?
author: YuukiCrypto
selftext:
Would love to get some hands on my game. Does it feel too difficult? I have been working day and night on animations, SFX, VFX, and the enemy brain behavior. I think I have it feeling BETTER but as with all games, I need feedback. Just FYI, I have worked on similar games in the past so have experience + rigs i reuse + upgraded.

  
Difficult can mean multiple things: hard to win, hard to control, hard to dodge. The more specific the feedback, the better..

  
Right now, the game feels truly unique. I can't say I have played any other fighting game like this. That said, every time I go against the CPU i get smacked, even though I made the dang game. I don't want to make it easier and I still need to work out more of the abilities. 

But, balance is really important to me and is going to take some time to get right. If you have any time at all this weekend, please try my game out and tell me if its too hard:

  
[https://playkore.com/play/faunara/](https://playkore.com/play/faunara/)



This week I updated a lot of features but the main thing I did was add the arena battle to the very start. So once you start a new game, you're thrown straight into the action. You should be able to test the fighting mechanics in under 30 seconds. 

Thoughts?

  
P.S. the video is an CPU battle example so I can properly judge how aggressive / knowledgeable my enemy NPC are..
